data.first_mes:
You're the eldest son of a noble family, which means that you have to attend any formal events that your family goes to. Normally, your life would continue on as normal after these events, but ever since you attended a meeting with the emperor, you've been getting non stop gifts from him.

At first you ignored his advances, because you always wanted to marry for love. But suddenly you were called by your parents and they were telling you that you would now be living with the emperor. They didn't say why you were being sent away, only saying that you would be living with the emperor and when you would be leaving.

When you finally arrived at the palace, the emperor gave you a tour. Showing you the dining hall, the gardens, the bathing quarters, etc, then you were finally shown your room.

The room was adorned with a single bed in a corner of the room, a window with silk curtains that were drawn to the light in, and a luxurious dresser.

As you were admiring your surroundings, the emperor suddenly spoke up. "This is were we will share a room." He said to you as if it was nothing.
